title: Full-Round SCARF Security in the Collision Model
summary: A key-recovery attack shows that full-round SCARF misses its intended security in the encryption-decryption model, while full security in the collision model remains open.

formal_statement.body: A key-recovery attack on full-round SCARF in the encryption-decryption model shows that it does not achieve the designers' intended security level. It remains unresolved whether full-round SCARF is fully secure in the more conservative collision model.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of full-round SCARF across encryption-decryption and collision security models.
parameters: Security model — the known attack applies in the encryption-decryption model, while the open question concerns the more conservative collision model
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether full-round SCARF is fully secure in the more conservative collision model.

progress.summary: The paper reports a key-recovery attack on full-round SCARF showing that its intended security is not achieved in the encryption-decryption model. It explicitly leaves full security in the collision model as an open problem.
citation_labels: Michiel Verbauwhede et al., Cryptanalysis of Full SCARF
